name: product-tracking
description: Skills that make SaaS products data-ready for product analytics: model the product, audit existing tracking, design a tracking plan, generate an SDK-specific implementation guide, implement typed tracking code, and keep the plan current as features ship.

interface.longDescription:
Accoil Product Tracking is a set of seven skills for engineers and product teams who need reliable product analytics in a B2B SaaS codebase.

What it does:
- Model the product: scan the codebase and ask a few questions to describe users, accounts, entities, and how value flows (.telemetry/product.md).
- Audit current tracking: inventory existing analytics SDK calls, identity handling, and event naming (.telemetry/current-state.yaml).
- Design a tracking plan: propose a minimal, consistently named set of events, properties, and group hierarchy, plus a delta from the current state (.telemetry/tracking-plan.yaml, .telemetry/delta.md).
- Generate an implementation guide for one of 25 destinations, such as Segment, Amplitude, Mixpanel, PostHog, RudderStack, Google Analytics, Sentry, LaunchDarkly, or a generic HTTP API (.telemetry/instrument.md).
- Implement tracking: generate typed wrapper functions and identity management code in a tracking/ directory.
- Instrument new features: update the plan, delta, and changelog when a feature ships, changes, or is removed.
- Write a business case for investing in product telemetry.

Limitations: the lifecycle skills read and write files in the user's repository, so this plugin is available in Codex only. The skills generate plans and code only; they do not send any data to Accoil or to analytics vendors, do not create analytics accounts, and do not define KPIs or build dashboards. Review generated code before merging.
capabilities: Scan a codebase for analytics tracking
defaultPrompt: Audit the analytics tracking in this codebase and save a current-state inventory.
Design a tracking plan for this product with users, accounts, and core events.
Generate typed tracking code from our tracking plan for our analytics SDK.
